tooltip.hydemod.tedx_invitation: Summon Sam Hyde on open ground. Watch attack warnings; interrupt his healing.
tooltip.hydemod.giant_goobers_box: Summon Elephant Mario on open ground. Jump his waves and sidestep his charge.
tooltip.hydemod.pipe_wrench: Click two pipes to link them across dimensions. Sneak-click a pipe to unlink.
message.hydemod.wrench.first: Pipe selected at %s %s %s. Now right-click the pipe to link it to.
message.hydemod.wrench.linked: Warp pipes linked! Stand on one and sneak to travel.
message.hydemod.wrench.missing: The other warp pipe is gone.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.unlinked: This warp pipe isn't linked. Use a Pipe Wrench on two pipes.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.linked: Linked to %s %s %s (%s). Hold sneak to warp; sneak-click with an empty hand to change the exit.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.blocked: Exit blocked! Clear space above the destination pipe, then release sneak to retry.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.arrived: Here we go! Release sneak before your next warp.
message.hydemod.wrench.unlinked: Pipe unlinked. Click two pipes to create a new route.
warning.hydemod.sam.close_eyes: CLOSE YOUR EYES — turn away from Sam!
warning.hydemod.sam.coffee: COFFEE BREAK — prepare for a faster Sam!
warning.hydemod.sam.pat: APPLAUSE — hit Sam to interrupt his healing!
warning.hydemod.sam.reset_clock: RESET THE CLOCK — interrupt his last chance!
warning.hydemod.sam.trash_rain: TRASH RAIN — leave the marked area!
warning.hydemod.elephant.pound: GROUND POUND — jump over the shockwave!
warning.hydemod.elephant.snack: SNACK BREAK — hit Mario to stop his healing!
warning.hydemod.elephant.charge: TRUNK CHARGE — sidestep the dust trail!
warning.hydemod.elephant.staggered: WALL BONK! Mario is open — attack!
warning.hydemod.elephant.interrupted: SNACK INTERRUPTED! Mario is open — attack!
message.hydemod.boss_no_room: Give the boss some room! Summon on clear, dry ground.
message.hydemod.boss_already_here: Finish the nearby boss fight before summoning another.
